items.content: The entry door is secured by an electronic lock with a touchscreen keypad. To lock the door from outside, press and hold the “#” key for about 2–3 seconds until it beeps.

To operate the key box: 1. Place the palm of your hand on the keypad to wake the device. 2. Enter the valid PIN code you received, then press the padlock icon in the center. 3. Wait for the beep and the noise of the lock opening. 4. Pull the side of the box to open it and retrieve the key. A video demonstration is also available: https://youtu.be/T3InNiScQLc?si=epQiYZC7dgVDPxRA

Exterior building door:
- The external entrance is a glass door with a digicode on the right side. It is usually open (installed after an incident in winter 2022).
- To unlock, enter “On puis 123456”. The keypad sends a signal to the barrel, which then opens the door. When not engaged, the lock turns freely without opening.
Cooktop manual available at: pro.howdens.fr
Standard check-out time is 11:00. Guests may request a late check-out until 12:00; approval depends on the housekeeping schedule and must be confirmed by the host.

If guests arrive in Lyon early and the apartment is not yet ready, they may be allowed to drop off luggage until around 13:00 (or 14:00) if there is no conflict with cleaning. This must be arranged in advance with the host.

Free street parking is available in the privileged hypercenter neighborhood, especially on Sundays, public holidays and in August. Paid parking zones apply from 9:00 to evening but are affordable and rarely enforced compared to downhill areas. Parking and unloading of luggage is usually possible on Rue Roger Radisson in front of the apartment. Other streets with a high probability of available spaces include Rue Pauline Marie Jaricot, Rue du Cardinal Gerlier, Montée du Télégraphe and Place du 158e Régiment d’Infanterie. The area is very quiet except during Fourvière festival nights.

A private garage is available at 29 Rue Roger Radisson (garage number 1 of 4, with its door facing the street). Guests can park there for €10 per stay. Host may occasionally waive this fee for last-minute bookings.

Public transport options nearby:
• Funiculaire F1 (Station Saint-Just) – 600 m: direct access to Vieux-Lyon and Metro D
• Funiculaire F2 (Station Fourvière) – 600 m: direct access to Vieux-Lyon and Metro D
• Bus 90 at Jaricot stop – 50 m
• Bus 55 and C21 at St-Alexandre stop – 700 m: connections to Perrache
The property address is 44 Rue Roger Radisson, Lyon 69005.

Airport transfer:
- Take the Rhône Express train to Vaulx-en-Velin–La Soie.
- Metro A to Bellecour.
- Metro D to Vieux Lyon.
- Funicular to St-Just or Fourvière.
- Uber or taxi options have a similar travel time.

Trains:
- 45 minutes from Part-Dieu by Metro B, then Metro D and funicular.
- 15 minutes from Perrache by bus C21 or 55.
The studio apartment does not have a sofa bed.

Virtual tour of the Lodge de Fourvière:
- Ground floor (accessible by three steps):
  - Living area with TV
  - Kitchen area
  - Bed corner
- At the entrance: small wardrobe closet, microwave, kettle
- Bathroom and separate WC
Pets and other domestic animals are not allowed in the apartment. This policy benefits allergy-sensitive travelers.
Events and parties are not permitted. A decibel detector and camera in the hallway monitor noise. Guests must respect neighbors and maintain quiet after 22:00.
Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the premises. Guests must not disable or move the CO₂ sensor, as it is connected to an alarm if disturbed.
Guests must report any damage or stains (e.g., on linens or duvets). The host may request compensation for dry-cleaning or replacement costs if damage is discovered without prior notification.

Guest count:
- Only the number of guests listed on the reservation is permitted.
- If extra persons arrive, please regularize the booking promptly.

If the door alarm is triggered or the electronic lock malfunctions, guests should wait 20–30 seconds and then try again. If problems persist, guests can use the backup key from the key box or contact the host, who lives nearby and can provide assistance quickly.
Tap water in the apartment is safe to drink and use for cooking.

Restaurants:
- Hotel Fourvière Lyon (50 m): Bar “Les Collections” and bistronomic restaurant “Les Téléphones”; open midday and evening. Address: 23 Rue Roger Radisson, 69005 Lyon. Tel: 04 74 70 07 00. https://www.fourviere-hotel.com/fr/
- L’Esprit Bristol (300 m): Terrace for 100, indoor dining for 45 with fireplace in a bucolic setting. Address: 20 Rue du Cardinal Gerlier, 69005 Lyon. Tel: 04 78 36 73 85. https://www.lespritbistrot.com/
- La Table de Saint Just (400 m): Warm welcome, refined yet straightforward cuisine. Address: 12 Rue des Basses Verchères, 69005 Lyon. Tel: 04 78 36 06 17. https://la-table-de-saint-just-lyon.fr/fr
- La Petite Auberge (800 m): Large summer terrace; fondue cheese by the fireplace in winter. Address: Place Eugène Wernert, 69005 Lyon. Tel: 04 78 25 29 33. https://lapetiteaubergelyon.fr/
- Restaurant Gastronomique Christian Tetedoie (700 m): Fine-dining restaurant with panoramic view; also Phosphore wine bar and tapas below. Address: 4 Rue Professeur Pierre Marion, 69005 Lyon. Tel: +33 4 78 29 40 10. https://tetedoie.fr/
- Chez Grand-Mère (800 m): Traditional bouchon cuisine in a vintage cellar décor. Address: 11 Rue du Bœuf, 69005 Lyon. Tel: 09 51 61 35 38. https://chezgrandmere.fr/
- Hermosa Pizza (Saint-Just): Takeaway pizza, ranked 3rd best pizza in Lyon by Le Bonbon. Tel: 09 87 12 05 88.

Attractions:
- Lugdunum Musée et théâtres romains (200 m): Gallo-Roman museum with free access to the amphitheaters. https://lugdunum.grandlyon.com/fr/
- Basilique de Fourvière (500 m): Iconic Lyon landmark with crypt and panoramic belvedere. https://www.fourviere.org/fr/
- Le Vieux Lyon (900 m): UNESCO-listed Renaissance district; accessible by funicular or montée du Gourguillon. https://www.visiterlyon.com/decouvrir/sites-et-monuments/renaissance/le-vieux-lyon
- Place des Terreaux (1 800 m): Historic square featuring the Bartholdi fountain.
- Musée des Confluences (4 000 m): Museum of anthropology and sciences in modern architecture. https://museedesconfluences.fr/fr
- Les Berges du Rhône (200 m): 5 km riverside promenade with bars, riverside boats, restaurants.

Shops & Services:
- Le Petit Casino (500 m): Local grocery store at 1 Rue de la Favorite, 69005 Lyon; reasonable for small shopping. Google Maps: Le Petit Casino
- Boulangerie Henri Gay (12 Rue de la Favorite, 69005 Lyon): Neighborhood bakery; hours may vary.
